## Tiers

- **Tier A** — Published PDF is cryptographically bound to the exact source that produced it. Ships a source-contract manifest, reproducibility package, external build receipt, and a verifier suite you can run offline.
- **Tier B** — Manuscript plus metadata, structurally linted and built to all four formats by CI. A real book with a lighter guarantee.

## Verify any download

```bash
gh attestation verify <file> --repo ankitkpandey1/handbooks
sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS.txt
```
